candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart creates a group of Marines as combat constructs

claim_citation.quote: John then uses his power to create a group of Marines, who fight alongside him against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.summary: Full construct feat: John manifests a squad of Marine constructs to fight with him. This is a tactical/assisted battlefield use of the ring rather than a permanent creation.
candidates.title: Blackest Night Marine squad
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John summons a whole Marine unit that joins the fight against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart fires a sniper-rifle construct into Mogo’s core

claim_citation.quote: John constructs a sniper rifle and fires a bullet into Mogo's core, killing the living planet and stopping the creation of corrupted rings.

candidates.summary: Full construct feat: John builds a precise sniper rifle construct and uses it to deliver the finishing shot that kills Mogo. This is one of his most lethal and technically detailed constructs.
candidates.title: The Mogo sniper shot
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John manifests a sniper rifle, takes aim, and shoots a bullet straight into Mogo’s core.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart's construct bubble holding Martian Manhunter back

claim_citation.quote: John arrogantly accuses J'onn of holding him back, and he restrains the Martian in a bubble before leaving to stop the Aspect alone.

candidates.summary: A partial but clearly shown construct feat: John uses a Green Lantern bubble to immobilize Martian Manhunter during the Xanshi mission. This is an extreme tactical use of a construct, but it is not the biggest thing he attempted in the story.
candidates.title: Cosmic Odyssey #2
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John cages J'onn in a green bubble and leaves him behind so he can handle the threat alone.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart's attempt to recreate Xanshi's solar system as a construct

claim_citation.quote: Fueled by his regret, he was able to temporarily manifest the entire system as a construct in the hopes of bringing it back again.

candidates.summary: This is the most insane classic John Stewart construct attempt in the retrieved sources: he tries to restore an entire destroyed solar system, even if only temporarily and unsuccessfully. It is the biggest-scale construct discussed in the material and the clearest candidate for 'most insane.'
candidates.title: Cosmic Odyssey #2
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John tries to will a destroyed world-system back into existence, but the attempt fails and the catastrophe still stands.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart's fully functional Kryptonian tele-disruptor construct

claim_citation.quote: Zod claims it would take weeks to construct such a device since it was lost to the ages, but Stewart proved him otherwise by building it in mere minutes using his ring.

candidates.series_issue_year: Unspecified in retrieved source; cited by CBR as a John Stewart comics feat
candidates.summary: A high-skill but not the biggest-scale construct: John rapidly builds an ancient alien device from blueprints. This is an assisted/temporary feat rather than a world-shaping one.
candidates.title: John Stewart's tele-disruptor construct
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John studies the blueprints and then manifests a working device in minutes.
